title: OpenAI signs letter of intent for Samsung memory chips for Stargate

sources.quote: As part of the partnership, Samsung Electronics will work with OpenAI as a strategic memory supplier for its Stargate initiative, aimed at building next-generation AI infrastructure.

OpenAI and several Samsung affiliates have signed a letter of intent (LOI) to work together on developing global AI data center infrastructure and advancing technologies that are essential for AI model training and inference.

explain: OpenAI and Samsung signed a non-binding letter of intent under which Samsung would supply memory chips for OpenAI's Stargate data centers, whose demand OpenAI projects at up to 900,000 DRAM wafers a month. No price or volume commitment was announced, so the money involved is unknown.
